g.text: FPGA = RANC simulator · measured inference 2.058 ms
From MNIST pixels to RANC spike votes
Two real PNG submissions · unchanged deployed weights · exact FPGA / simulator output agreement
Read top to bottom. Hidden 8×8 tiles arrange neuron IDs; they are not spatial feature maps. Hidden spikes are model reconstructions.
Output tiles are saved FPGA measurements. Each lit cell contributes one vote to its class column; a row may vote for several classes.
Votes are spike counts, not probabilities. Inference timing excludes host preprocessing/upload and the two blank flushing steps.
